question.en: What must you do before moving off from a stationary position at the side of the road?
question.af: [AF] What must you do before moving off from a stationary position at the side of the road?
question.xh: [XH] What must you do before moving off from a stationary position at the side of the road?
question.zu: [ZU] What must you do before moving off from a stationary position at the side of the road?
question.st: [ST] What must you do before moving off from a stationary position at the side of the road?

en.A: A. Check mirrors and blind spots, signal intention, select gear, obtain clutch control, release parking brake, and move off when safe.
en.B: B. Release the parking brake immediately and accelerate into traffic.
en.C: C. Sound the hooter to warn approaching traffic before moving off.
